entities.name: Valeria Ortuño Martínez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Valeria Ortuño Martínez is a Mexican racewalker. She competed in the women's 20 kilometres walk event at the 2019 World Athletics Championships held in Doha, Qatar. She finished in 32nd place with a time of 1:43:51. She also competed in the same event at the 2022 World Athletics Championships held in Eugene, Oregon, United States.
